page_title: ATA 3-2 FIO | Atalanta v Fiorentina 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
90+3' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

87' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
82' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

82' What a big chance! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
81' Luca Ranieri goes off the pitch and Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) comes on.
79' Charles De Ketelaere picks out Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta), who drives a shot just over the crossbar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
76' Excellent touch by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.

75' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but David de Gea was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
74' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) replaces Danilo Cataldi.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edoardo Bove leaves the pitch and Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) comes on.

74' Ederson (Atalanta) watches the cross in from Raoul Bellanova, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
73' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
70' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replacing Mateo Retegui.
70' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has come on for Matteo Ruggeri.
69' Juan Luca Sacchi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle. Atalanta have a free kick.
67' The referee gives a yellow card to Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).

64' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Fiorentina are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
62' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Andrea Colpani cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom right corner from distance, but Marco Carnesecchi hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.

57' Charles De Ketelaere plays a pass to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
56' The referee blows his whistle as Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was too aggressive in his challenge. Fiorentina have a free kick.
56' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Juan Luca Sacchi signals a set piece. Fiorentina earn a free kick.
55' The players claim that Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) handled the ball and it seems they are right. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' Fiorentina are ruled offside.
51' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) sends a long ball forward to Robin Gosens, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
50' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
49' Mateo Retegui provides the assist in the box, but Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
48' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends it out of play.
48' Wow, what an escape. Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) has come on in place of Isak Hien.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' 3 - 2 A great individual effort by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta)! Showcasing his skills, he found his way deep inside the box and produced a low shot which goes into the bottom left corner. A quite a remarkable goal!
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 2 Superbly taken set piece! Ederson takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) flicks the ball lightly with his head towards the middle of the goal. David de Gea can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 2:2.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) sends a long ball in, but David de Gea comfortably gathers the ball.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
42' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
41' A cross into the box from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is cleared. Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.
41' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
39' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

36' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the left-hand post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
36' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Fiorentina will take a free kick.

35' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) meets a cross from Raoul Bellanova, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
32' 1 - 2 GOAL! Robin Gosens meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Moise Kean (Fiorentina) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:2.
31' The game is interrupted as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
27' Isak Hien (Atalanta) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
26' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
24' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) makes a slide tackle, but referee Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. Atalanta are awarded the free kick.

21' 1 - 1 Ademola Lookman sends a superb cross into the box. Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving David de Gea beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
21' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) leaps to collect the ball.
20' Dodo (Fiorentina) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
19' Atalanta continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
18' Atalanta are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Juan Luca Sacchi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

15' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
15' Marco Carnesecchi makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) after a cross from the side.
15' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
14' An attempted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
14' Isak Hien (Atalanta) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Fiorentina.
13' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. A free kick to Fiorentina.
12' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
10' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Atalanta.

9' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi was alert and made an astonishing save!
6' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Luca Sacchi saw the whole situation. Atalanta get a free kick.
2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
